title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Renewal Assessment: Unrelieved Laboratory Burden Against the Catastrophic Threshold
content:
**Assessment rule.** A renewal application under the Patient Financial Assistance Program is assessed at the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment when the household's unrelieved laboratory burden is greater than its catastrophic threshold and the documented percent of the poverty guideline on the award being renewed is at most 600 percent; otherwise it is assessed at the tier of the award being renewed.

**Unrelieved laboratory burden.** The unrelieved laboratory burden is the patient responsibility posted on the household's invoices within the burden window, less every courtesy adjustment, billing-error correction, estimate-dispute settlement and small-balance write-off posted within the burden window, less the financial-assistance discounts the award being renewed granted within the burden window. The burden is stated to the cent.

**Burden window.** The burden window holds every entry dated fewer than 12 months before today, counted in whole calendar months from the entry's date to today.

**Catastrophic threshold.** The catastrophic threshold is 10 percent of the documented annual household income on the award being renewed, rounded to the cent.

## Reading the window (hypothetical dates, today 15 September 2026)

| Entry dated | Whole calendar months from the entry's date to today | In the burden window |
|---|---|---|
| 16 September 2025 | 11 | Yes |
| 15 September 2025 | 12 | No |
| 3 March 2026 | 6 | Yes |

## Worked assessment (hypothetical household renewing a Financial Assistance 50% Discount award)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Documented annual household income on the award being renewed | $41250.00 |
| Documented percent of the poverty guideline on that award | 265.4 |
| Patient responsibility posted within the burden window | $6380.00 |
| Courtesy, billing-error, estimate-dispute and small-balance adjustments posted within the window | $210.00 |
| Financial-assistance discounts the award being renewed granted within the window | $1900.00 |
| Unrelieved laboratory burden: $6380.00 less $210.00 less $1900.00 | $4270.00 |
| Catastrophic threshold: 10 percent of $41250.00 | $4125.00 |

The burden of $4270.00 is greater than the threshold of $4125.00, and 265.4 percent is at most 600 percent, so the renewal is assessed at the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment.

**Boundary.** Had the burden been exactly $4125.00 it would not be greater than the threshold, and the renewal would be assessed at the tier of the award being renewed, the Financial Assistance 50% Discount. A household documented at 600.0 percent meets the percent condition; one documented at 600.1 percent does not.
